title: Two versions of an app conflict
symptom: Two versions of the same PDF reader are installed and files open unpredictably
user_description: I have two PDF programs that look nearly the same. Sometimes one opens, sometimes the other, and some features don't work.

options.text: Delete the program folders by hand
options.why: Leaves broken leftovers and may remove files other programs need. Always uninstall properly.

options.text: Install a third version to see which one works
options.why: Makes the conflict worse and adds more clutter.

options.text: Check installed apps, decide which version is approved and needed, uninstall the extra version properly, repair the remaining one and restart
options.why: Two versions compete to open the same files. Removing the unneeded one properly and repairing the other restores predictable behaviour.
A huge fix for a simple duplicate program.

hints: Which version should he really be using?
What is the proper way to remove a program?
What could you do to make sure the remaining one works?
real_world_tip: Check the version numbers. The newer one is not always the approved one, so compare against your approved list.
